semiconductor_relevance: High — Kinryo Electric provides specialized equipment for real-time contamination monitoring in semiconductor cleanrooms.
summary: Kinryo Electric exhibits the SIFT-MS, a mass spectrometer designed for real-time analysis of airborne molecular contaminants (AMCs) in semiconductor manufacturing environments. This equipment is crucial for maintaining cleanroom standards by detecting and quantifying contaminants such as VOCs and inorganic compounds with high sensitivity.
capabilities: Real-time monitoring of airborne molecular contaminants (AMCs)
Portable mass spectrometry for cleanroom applications
Detection of multiple volatile organic and inorganic compounds
